candidate_review.selection_reason: Three different sectors (analog semiconductors, consumer-electronics retail, Chinese EV maker) from results filed 24-25 November 2026, none covered in the previous 14 days by any Compound company task (daily, private-company, Mag 8) and none in progress today. Autodesk was set aside because enterprise software (Workday) ran on 27 November; Burlington because Best Buy already covers US retail today; HP overlaps Dell's PC exposure (27 November); PDD's 6-K was not a results release when screened on 27 November.
